name: Citizenship by Naturalisation

requirements.blocker_text: 10 years' ordinary residence in Senegal, reduced to 5 years for applicants married to a Senegalese woman, employed in Senegalese public institutions, or providing exceptional services to Senegal. Applicant must be 18+, of good character (no non-political custodial convictions), and not deemed a burden on the community by reason of mental or physical unfitness. Naturalization is granted by government decree; no decision within 1 year of filing constitutes rejection (Article 11).
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 10 years' residence (or 5 years under a qualifying reduced category), then apply for naturalization by decree.

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: 10 years' ordinary residence, or 5 years under a qualifying reduced category

sources.title: ecoi.net, hosting an Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada (IRB) research response on Senegal's citizenship law -- naturalization requirements: 10 years' ordinary residence (or 5 years for spouses of Senegalese women, public-institution employees, or those rendering exceptional service), age 18+, good character, mental/physical fitness, decision by government decree with a 1-year default-rejection rule (Article 11), and Article 16b's incompatibility of decree-acquired citizenship with any other nationality

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Senegal). STATUS: DRAFT -- same tier-2 sourcing limitation as this country's other citizenship files; Senegal's own Journal Officiel or government legal portal was not located/fetched in this build. GENUINE, DISTINCTIVE PROCEDURAL FINDING: Article 11's 1-year default-rejection rule (silence from the government for 1 year after filing counts as a denial) is a specific, sourced due-process feature not seen in quite this form in most other naturalization routes built in this dataset. dual_citizenship_allowed set false: naturalization is citizenship 'acquired by a decision of the government,' which Article 16b explicitly makes 'incompatible with any other allegiance' -- unlike descent-based citizenship (sn_citizenship_by_descent.json), which does allow a period of dual nationality before an 18-25 choice is made.
